Maya (Product): Heads up — infra hit pushed some Dedicated nodes by ~2 weeks. Need to decide scope for upcoming launch milestone.
Liam (Eng): Can you call out which APIs are impacted? latency or capacity?
Maya (Product): Dedicated pools delay affects burst capacity and tenant isolation for v1. MVP hosted path unaffected. Main ask from sales: enterprise SSO + per-tenant routing for direct customers.
Raj (Sales): yep — two pilot customers need SSO and routing for launch, but both said MVP can be barebones if we promise v1 within 6 weeks after MVP.
Anita (Design): UX for SSO sign-in is scoped small. Biggest time sink is admin tenancy UI (tenant onboarding + keys).
Liam (Eng): Proposal: ship MVP as hosted-only with tenant-level config disabled, include token-based auth and SAML placeholder. Defer admin onboarding and dedicated routing to v1.
Tom (SRE): Ops concern: if we disable tenant routing, we still need canary and fallback policies. Need clear rollback triggers.
Maya (Product): Agree. Proposed milestone reset plan:
Maya (Product): - MVP launch (hosted, tokens + basic SSO redirect) — target +0 days
Maya (Product): - v1 (Dedicated/pinning + admin onboarding + SSO pilot) — target +42 days
Liam (Eng): I can land engineering cutlist. Suggest hard cuts: remove admin UI, postpone per-tenant metrics, no reserved capacity in MVP.
Anita (Design): I'll slim SSO screens to just redirect & error states. Deliverables: 2 mock screens + copy.
Raj (Sales): I can negotiate pilot acceptance window with customers if we commit to 6-week v1. Appreciate a clear fallback.
Liam (Eng): Quick gating config suggestion for rollout:
Liam (Eng): ```
canary: 5%
fallthrough: hosted-only
alerts:
  latency_p95: >600ms over 10m -> rollback
```
Maya (Product): Action items: Liam create cutlist PR by EOD, Anita deliver mocks by tomorrow noon, Tom add rollback alert to runbook, Raj update customers. We'll reconvene 11:30am.
deploy-bot: Note: new canary rule added to staging at 07:12 UTC :robot_face:
Maya (Product): Thanks — this preserves MVP momentum while promising v1 timeline. :thumbsup:
